papers.title: Alternative multiport robotic platforms versus da Vinci in colorectal cancer surgery: a systematic review and platform-stratified meta-analysis
papers.authors: Altamimi A, Alanazi R, Al-Mohy M, Al-Shahrani S, Aldalbahi F, Al Manaa N
papers.abstract: Alternative multiport robotic systems from manufacturers other than Intuitive Surgical are being adopted for colorectal cancer procedures, yet how their outcomes compare with the established da Vinci platform remains unclear. PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, and CENTRAL were searched through August 2026 for randomised trials and comparative observational studies of alternative multiport robots versus da Vinci for colorectal cancer surgery. Random-effects risk ratios (RRs) and mean differences were stratified by platform and resection site; RoB 2, ROBINS-I and GRADE were applied. Twelve studies (one randomised trial; 1,144 participants: 557 alternative platform, 587 da Vinci) evaluated six platforms; hinotori was assessed in six studies and four platforms in one study each. Five cohorts were at serious risk of bias. Console time was 29.38 min longer with alternative platforms (95% CI 17.87 to 40.89; low certainty; mainly hinotori). Total operative time was 20.04 min longer (95% CI 8.81 to 31.28), but heterogeneity and small-study effects made this very uncertain (trim-and-fill estimate 7.24 min, - 4.20 to 18.69). Morbidity estimates were imprecise: Clavien-Dindo grade ≥ II complications RR 1.17 (0.91 to 1.51), grade ≥ III RR 0.86 (0.44 to 1.69), and anastomotic leak RR 1.35 (0.47 to 3.89; 17 events). Certainty was very low for all other outcomes. Alternative multiport robots appear feasible for colorectal cancer surgery but may prolong console time. Their comparative safety and pathological quality relative to da Vinci remain uncertain, and current data do not establish equivalence or non-inferiority. Adequately powered, platform-specific prospective comparisons with predefined non-inferiority margins are required.

papers.abstract_zh: Intuitive Surgical 以外製造商生產的替代性多孔機器人系統，正逐漸應用於大腸直腸癌手術，但其結果與已廣泛使用的 da Vinci 平台相比如何，仍不清楚。本研究搜尋 PubMed、Web of Science、Scopus 及 CENTRAL，納入截至 2026 年 8 月比較替代性多孔機器人與 da Vinci 用於大腸直腸癌手術的隨機試驗及比較性觀察研究。以隨機效應模型估計風險比（RR）與平均差，並依平台及切除部位分層；採用 RoB 2、ROBINS-I 與 GRADE 進行評估。共納入 12 項研究（其中 1 項為隨機試驗；共 1,144 名參與者：替代平台組 557 人、da Vinci 組 587 人），評估 6 種平台；hinotori 有 6 項研究評估，另有 4 種平台各僅有 1 項研究。5 個世代研究具有嚴重偏差風險。替代平台的主控台操作時間較長，平均增加 29.38 分鐘（95% CI 17.87 至 40.89；低確定性；資料主要來自 hinotori）。總手術時間平均增加 20.04 分鐘（95% CI 8.81 至 31.28），但異質性及小型研究效應使此結果非常不確定（剪補法估計為 7.24 分鐘，95% CI −4.20 至 18.69）。併發症估計值不精確：Clavien-Dindo 第 II 級以上併發症 RR 為 1.17（0.91 至 1.51），第 III 級以上併發症 RR 為 0.86（0.44 至 1.69），吻合口滲漏 RR 為 1.35（0.47 至 3.89；17 起事件）。所有其他結果的證據確定性皆為極低。替代性多孔機器人用於大腸直腸癌手術似乎可行，但可能延長主控台操作時間。其相對於 da Vinci 的比較安全性與病理品質仍不確定，目前資料無法確立等效性或非劣性。未來需要具足夠統計檢定力、針對個別平台，且預先設定非劣性界值的前瞻性比較研究。

papers.title: A machine learning model for predicting early adverse outcomes after surgery in patients with early-onset rectal cancer: a two-center retrospective cohort study
papers.authors: Yue X, Zhang G, Cao H, Zhao X, Sun Y, Zhang X
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Patients often present at advanced stages of early-onset rectal cancer (EORC), which is becoming more common. Within a year following rectal resection, some patients experience early adverse outcomes (EAO), such as severe complications, recurrence, or death; however, there is currently no validated postoperative risk-stratification tool for this population. Current prognostic models concentrate on individual endpoints rather than the composite adversity spectrum that is pertinent to younger patients because they were mostly established in older cohorts. This work sought to create and externally validate a model for detecting EORC patients at greater risk of EAO using a stacking ensemble machine learning approach with SHAP interpretability in order to guide individualized postoperative surveillance and adjuvant therapy decisions.
METHODS: In this two-center retrospective cohort study, 648 EORC patients from Center A (2020-2025) constituted the development cohort and 102 patients from Center B (2024-2025) the external validation cohort. Eleven individual machine learning models and a two-layer stacking ensemble (combining three base learners with logistic regression meta-learner) were trained. Model performance was assessed by area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), calibration, and decision curve analysis.
RESULTS: Boruta feature selection identified eleven important predictors, with pathological T stage (pT), lymphovascular invasion (LVI), and pathological TNM stage (pTNM) contributing most to model predictions. The stacking ensemble outperformed all 11 individual models, achieving AUCs of 0.91 (95% CI 0.88-0.93) in the training set, 0.89 (95% CI 0.85-0.94) in the internal validation set, and 0.83 (95% CI 0.76-0.91) in the external validation cohort, with a Brier score of 0.1104 and sustained net benefit on decision curve analysis. An interactive web calculator was deployed for individualized risk assessment.
CONCLUSION: An interpretable stacking ensemble model integrating SHAP analysis and a web-based calculator showed promising predictive performance for EAO following EORC surgery. Designed for postoperative use once pathology data are available, the model provides a comprehensive risk estimate to guide surveillance intensity and interdisciplinary adjuvant therapy decision-making.

papers.title_zh: 預測早發性直腸癌病人術後早期不良結局的機器學習模型：雙中心回溯性世代研究
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：早發性直腸癌（EORC）日益常見，病人就診時往往已處於較晚期。直腸切除術後一年內，部分病人會發生早期不良結局（EAO），例如嚴重併發症、復發或死亡；然而，目前尚無針對此族群經驗證的術後風險分層工具。現有預後模型大多建立於年長族群，因此著重個別終點，而非與年輕病人相關的複合不良結局範疇。本研究旨在運用具備 SHAP 可解釋性的堆疊集成機器學習方法，建立並外部驗證可辨識 EAO 高風險 EORC 病人的模型，以協助個人化術後追蹤及輔助治療決策。
方法：本雙中心回溯性世代研究納入 A 中心於 2020–2025 年間的 648 名 EORC 病人作為模型開發世代，以及 B 中心於 2024–2025 年間的 102 名病人作為外部驗證世代。研究訓練了 11 種個別機器學習模型，以及一個雙層堆疊集成模型，後者結合三個基礎學習器與邏輯斯迴歸後設學習器。模型表現以接收者操作特徵曲線下面積（AUC）、校準度及決策曲線分析評估。
結果：Boruta 特徵選擇法辨識出 11 項重要預測因子，其中病理 T 分期（pT）、淋巴血管侵犯（LVI）及病理 TNM 分期（pTNM）對模型預測的貢獻最大。堆疊集成模型的表現優於全部 11 種個別模型，在訓練集、內部驗證集及外部驗證世代的 AUC 分別為 0.91（95% CI 0.88–0.93）、0.89（95% CI 0.85–0.94）及 0.83（95% CI 0.76–0.91），Brier 分數為 0.1104，且決策曲線分析顯示持續的淨效益。研究亦部署了互動式網頁計算器，以進行個人化風險評估。
結論：整合 SHAP 分析及網頁計算器的可解釋堆疊集成模型，對 EORC 手術後 EAO 展現具潛力的預測表現。此模型設計於術後病理資料取得後使用，提供綜合風險估計，以協助決定追蹤強度及跨專科輔助治療。

papers.title: The gut microbiota: a key modulator of radiotherapy efficacy and toxicity in colorectal cancer
papers.authors: He X, Yu Y, Wang N, Ma S, Zhang Y, Fang Z
papers.abstract: The gut microbiota plays a critical role in modulating both the efficacy and toxicity of radiotherapy in patients with colorectal cancer (CRC). This review synthesizes current evidence on the bidirectional interaction between the gut microbiome and radiotherapy, highlighting the mechanisms through which microbial communities influence radiosensitivity and treatment-related adverse effects. Specific microbiota-derived metabolites, such as short-chain fatty acids and methylglyoxal, can enhance the radiotherapeutic response by exacerbating DNA damage, promoting immunogenic cell death, and activating antitumor immunity. Conversely, dysbiosis may contribute to radioresistance and exacerbate radiation-induced enteritis by impairing intestinal barrier function and amplifying inflammatory responses. Therapeutic strategies targeting the gut microbiome-including probiotics, prebiotics, antibiotics, and fecal microbiota transplantation-show promise in improving radiotherapy outcomes and mitigating toxicity. However, its clinical application remains limited by issues of safety, variability in individual microbiome composition, and lack of standardized protocols. Further high-quality clinical trials are essential to validate these interventions and advance personalized microbial modulation approaches in CRC radiotherapy.

papers.title_zh: 腸道微生物叢：大腸直腸癌放射治療療效與毒性的關鍵調節因子
papers.abstract_zh: 腸道微生物叢在調節大腸直腸癌（CRC）病人放射治療的療效與毒性方面，扮演關鍵角色。本綜述整合腸道微生物叢與放射治療之間雙向交互作用的現有證據，重點說明微生物群落影響放射敏感性及治療相關不良反應的機轉。特定的微生物叢衍生代謝物，例如短鏈脂肪酸與甲基乙二醛，可藉由加劇 DNA 損傷、促進免疫原性細胞死亡，以及活化抗腫瘤免疫，增強放射治療反應。相反地，菌相失衡可能透過損害腸道屏障功能及放大發炎反應，促成放射抗性並加劇放射性腸炎。針對腸道微生物叢的治療策略，包括益生菌、益生質、抗生素及糞便微生物叢移植，在改善放射治療結果及減輕毒性方面展現潛力。然而，其臨床應用仍受到安全性、個體間微生物叢組成差異，以及缺乏標準化流程等問題的限制。仍須進一步進行高品質臨床試驗，以驗證這些介入措施，並推進 CRC 放射治療中個人化微生物調節策略的發展。

papers.title: From uptake to interface: rethinking molecular imaging of histopathological growth patterns in colorectal cancer liver metastases
papers.authors: Li Q, Kang L, Zhang Z
papers.abstract: Recent work has proposed molecular imaging signatures, including [18F]FDG and fibroblast activation protein inhibitor (FAPI) PET, for the noninvasive characterization of histopathological growth patterns (HGPs) in colorectal cancer liver metastases (CRLM). We suggest that the spatial nature of HGPs warrants further consideration. Because HGPs are defined at the tumor-liver interface and may exhibit intralesional heterogeneity, whole-lesion tracer uptake may not fully capture the complex tumor-host interactions underlying these phenotypes. FAPI uptake may reflect fibroblast-rich stromal remodeling but should not be considered a direct surrogate for desmoplastic HGP. Future imaging-pathology studies could therefore move beyond conventional SUV-based assessment toward spatially resolved, interface-oriented molecular phenotyping. Quantifying tracer uptake and heterogeneity at the tumor-liver interface, together with longitudinal multimodal imaging, may provide complementary information on the dynamic metastatic microenvironment. Prospective studies integrating molecular imaging with standardized HGP assessment and spatially matched histopathology are warranted to determine the clinical value of this approach.

papers.title: Exosome-derived strategies for colorectal cancer: clinical trials and future directions
papers.journal_full: The Journal of pharmacy and pharmacology
papers.authors: Kumar V, Chauhan A, Pal R, Kumar M, Awasthi A
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: To highlight the potential of exosomes as biocompatible nanocarriers for CRC diagnosis and therapy and discuss their sources, isolation, applications, clinical trials, advancements, and challenges.
METHODS: Relevant literature on exosome biology, CRC pathogenesis, isolation, therapeutic applications, engineered exosomes, and clinical development was reviewed.
KEY FINDINGS: Exosomes offer low immunogenicity, high biocompatibility, and efficient cargo delivery, making them promising carriers for chemotherapeutic drugs, miRNAs, siRNAs, proteins, and immunomodulators. However, heterogeneity, standardization, cargo loading, manufacturing, targeting, and safety remain major challenges.
CONCLUSIONS: Exosome-based systems represent a promising approach for improving CRC diagnosis and treatment. Further optimization and clinical validation are required for successful translation into clinical practice.

papers.title: GAPDH Post-Translational Modifications as Molecular Switches in Cancer Metabolism and Tumor Microenvironment Remodeling
papers.authors: Jiang Z, Zhou Z, Qian X, Chen Q, Huang P
papers.abstract: Glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (GAPDH) is a multifunctional protein that participates in cancer metabolism, apoptosis, DNA repair, angiogenesis, and immune regulation beyond its canonical glycolytic role. However, how distinct post-translational modifications (PTMs) coordinate GAPDH functional transitions and determine its diverse biological roles in cancer remains incompletely understood. In this review, we summarize current advances in GAPDH PTMs, including methylation, phosphorylation, acetylation, ubiquitination, S-nitrosylation, serotonylation, crotonylation, lactylation, and succinylation, with emphasis on modification sites, regulatory enzymes, cellular contexts, and functional consequences. We propose a PTM-driven molecular switching model in which different cellular stimuli induce specific GAPDH modifications to regulate its enzymatic activity, subcellular localization, and protein interactions. Representative mechanisms include Src-mediated Tyr41 phosphorylation promoting DNA repair and 5-fluorouracil resistance in colorectal cancer, K254 and K160 acetylation regulating glycolytic activity and apoptosis through distinct cellular contexts, Parkin-mediated ubiquitination controlling mitophagy and metabolic reprogramming, and Gln262 serotonylation enhancing CD8+ T-cell glycolytic function and antitumor immunity. We further discuss the crosstalk among GAPDH PTMs and critically evaluate the current evidence, limitations, and therapeutic implications of GAPDH modification-based regulation. Although GAPDH PTMs represent promising targets for cancer intervention, current evidence is mainly derived from cellular and preclinical models, and PTM-specific therapeutic strategies remain limited. Further studies are required to clarify the cancer-specific functions and clinical relevance of GAPDH PTM networks.

papers.abstract_zh: 甘油醛-3-磷酸去氫酶（GAPDH）是一種多功能蛋白質，除了典型的糖解作用外，也參與癌症代謝、細胞凋亡、DNA 修復、血管新生及免疫調控。然而，不同的轉譯後修飾（PTMs）如何協調 GAPDH 的功能轉換，並決定其在癌症中的多樣生物學角色，目前仍未完全釐清。本綜述彙整 GAPDH 轉譯後修飾的最新進展，包括甲基化、磷酸化、乙醯化、泛素化、S-亞硝基化、血清素化、巴豆醯化、乳醯化及琥珀醯化，並著重於修飾位點、調控酵素、細胞情境及功能後果。我們提出一個由轉譯後修飾驅動的分子開關模型：不同的細胞刺激會誘發特定的 GAPDH 修飾，進而調控其酵素活性、次細胞定位及蛋白質交互作用。代表性機轉包括：Src 介導的 Tyr41 磷酸化可促進大腸直腸癌的 DNA 修復與 5-fluorouracil 抗藥性；K254 與 K160 的乙醯化在不同細胞情境下調控糖解活性與細胞凋亡；Parkin 介導的泛素化控制粒線體自噬與代謝重編程；以及 Gln262 血清素化增強 CD8+ T 細胞的糖解功能與抗腫瘤免疫。我們進一步討論 GAPDH 各種轉譯後修飾之間的交互調控，並批判性評估以 GAPDH 修飾為基礎之調控機制的現有證據、限制及治療意涵。雖然 GAPDH 轉譯後修飾是具有潛力的癌症介入標的，但目前證據主要來自細胞與臨床前模型，且針對特定轉譯後修飾的治療策略仍然有限。仍需進一步研究，以釐清 GAPDH 轉譯後修飾網絡在不同癌症中的特定功能及其臨床相關性。

papers.title: Weight-loss interventions in gastrointestinal and liver diseases: a narrative review of GLP-1 based therapies, bariatric surgery, and endoscopic approaches
papers.authors: Atieh J, Maselli D, Camilleri M
papers.abstract: Obesity and metabolic dysfunction are increasingly prevalent in patients with diverse gastrointestinal and liver diseases and contribute to disease progression, treatment response, and long-term clinical outcomes. In parallel, the therapeutic landscape for obesity has expanded rapidly, with growing use of incretin receptor agonists (RA), including glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP1)-RA, bariatric surgery, and endoscopic bariatric therapies. Understanding how these weight-loss interventions influence gastrointestinal disease activity, safety, and malignancy risk is essential for clinical decision-making. This narrative review synthesizes current evidence on the effects of obesity as well as weight-loss therapies across a spectrum of gastrointestinal and liver conditions, including metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), gastroesophageal reflux disease, celiac disease, gastrointestinal malignancies, and dumping syndrome. We summarize data from randomized trials, observational cohorts, and meta-analyses evaluating clinical outcomes, disease activity, adverse events, and cancer risk. In MASLD, GLP1-RA and bariatric surgery improve hepatic steatosis and steatohepatitis without aggravation of fibrosis. Fibrosis outcomes are most strongly influenced by sustained weight loss and improvements in insulin resistance. In IBD, obesity (particularly increased visceral fat) may negatively impact response to biologics; however, observational data suggest that GLP1-RA are not associated with increased IBD disease activity and may be associated with favorable clinical outcomes in selected patients with obesity. Bariatric surgery-particularly sleeve gastrectomy-may improve IBD control in carefully selected patients. Data on endoscopic bariatric therapies in IBD are limited but may be effective in selected patients. Gastrointestinal malignancies have increased prevalence in obesity, including esophageal, pancreatic, liver, and colorectal cancers. Current randomized and observational data do not demonstrate consistently increased cancer risk with GLP-1 based therapies, while bariatric surgery may be associated with reduced risk of selected obesity-related cancers. Evidence linking endoscopic bariatric therapies to malignancy risk is currently lacking. Dumping syndrome is a complication of bariatric surgery, but has not been reported following endoscopic bariatric therapies, likely due to delayed gastric emptying. Collectively, weight-loss therapies are increasingly important in the management of gastrointestinal and liver diseases. Ongoing studies and longer-term follow-up are needed to clarify durability of benefit, procedure-specific risks, and optimal patient selection for GLP-1 based therapies.

papers.abstract_zh: 肥胖與代謝功能障礙在各類胃腸與肝臟疾病病人中日益普遍，並影響疾病進展、治療反應及長期臨床結局。同時，肥胖治療領域迅速擴展，腸泌素受體促效劑（RA），包括類升糖素胜肽-1受體促效劑（GLP1-RA）、減重手術及內視鏡減重治療的使用日益增加。了解這些減重介入如何影響胃腸疾病活動度、安全性與惡性腫瘤風險，對臨床決策至關重要。本敘述性綜述整合目前關於肥胖及減重療法對多種胃腸與肝臟疾病影響的證據，涵蓋代謝功能障礙相關脂肪性肝病（MASLD）、發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）、胃食道逆流疾病、乳糜瀉、胃腸道惡性腫瘤及傾食症候群。我們彙整隨機試驗、觀察性世代研究及統合分析中，評估臨床結局、疾病活動度、不良事件與癌症風險的資料。在 MASLD 中，GLP1-RA 與減重手術可改善肝脂肪變性及脂肪性肝炎，且不使纖維化惡化。纖維化結局主要受持續減重及胰島素阻抗改善所影響。在 IBD 中，肥胖，尤其內臟脂肪增加，可能不利於生物製劑的治療反應；然而，觀察性資料顯示，GLP1-RA 與 IBD 疾病活動度增加無關，且在經篩選的肥胖病人中，可能與較佳臨床結局相關。減重手術，尤其袖狀胃切除術，可能改善經審慎篩選病人的 IBD 控制。IBD 病人接受內視鏡減重治療的資料有限，但此類治療對經篩選的病人可能有效。肥胖族群的胃腸道惡性腫瘤盛行率較高，包括食道癌、胰臟癌、肝癌與大腸直腸癌。目前的隨機與觀察性資料並未一致顯示 GLP-1 類療法會增加癌症風險，而減重手術可能與某些肥胖相關癌症風險降低有關。目前尚缺乏內視鏡減重治療與惡性腫瘤風險關聯的證據。傾食症候群是減重手術的併發症，但內視鏡減重治療後尚未有相關報告，可能是因為胃排空延遲。整體而言，減重療法在胃腸與肝臟疾病管理中的重要性日益增加。仍需進行中的研究及更長期追蹤，以釐清 GLP-1 類療法效益的持久性、各術式特有風險，以及最佳病人選擇。

papers.title: Hierarchical benefit of multidimensional remission in ulcerative colitis: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.authors: Zhang J, Zhong S, Ma M, Lin Z, Ma Y, Padungkiettiwong W
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Current treat-to-target strategies for ulcerative colitis (UC) prioritize clinical remission (CR) and endoscopic remission (ER). However, whether achieving deeper remission (histologic remission [HR] or biochemical remission [BR]) confers incremental and sustained benefit beyond CR-ER endpoints remains unquantified. This study aimed to provide evidence supporting the hierarchical benefit of multidimensional remission on critical outcomes in UC.
METHODS: We systematically searched Medline, EMBASE, and Cochrane CENTRAL from inception to 19 May 2025 for cohort studies enrolling adults with UC in CR, with ≥ 6 months of follow-up, comparing relapse risk, corticosteroid reintroduction, hospitalization, colectomy, and colorectal cancer rates among patients achieving ER versus non-ER, HR versus non-HR, and/or BR versus non-BR. Data were synthesized using random-effects meta-analysis. The certainty of evidence was evaluated with GRADE.
RESULTS: 94 studies (12,634 patients) were included. Compared to non-ER, ER reduced relapse risk by 44%-72% between 6 to < 60 months and corticosteroid reintroduction risk by 70% at 12 months (relative risks [RR] 0.30 [95% CI, 0.10-0.90]; very low certainty). Adding HR to CR + ER further reduced relapse risk by 51%-72% across all follow-up intervals: 12-24 months (0.46 [0.34-0.62]; moderate certainty), 24-36 months (0.48 [0.36-0.64]; moderate certainty), 48-60 months (0.28 [0.16-0.51]; low certainty), and ≥ 60 months (0.49 [0.34-0.71]; low certainty). Adding BR to CR + ER provided additional risk reduction of 71% at 12-month (0.29 [0.16-0.50]); moderate certainty), and 29% at ≥ 60 months (0.71 [0.51-0.97]; very low certainty).
CONCLUSIONS: This meta-analysis suggests a hierarchical benefit of multidimensional remission in UC. Achieving HR or BR beyond CR-ER endpoints substantially and sustainably reduces relapse risk. These results suggest that HR and BR may be considered as potential treatment targets to optimize long-term disease control.

papers.title_zh: 潰瘍性結腸炎多維度緩解的階層式效益：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：目前潰瘍性結腸炎（UC）的達標治療策略，優先追求臨床緩解（CR）與內視鏡緩解（ER）。然而，達到更深層的緩解〔組織學緩解（HR）或生化緩解（BR）〕，是否能在CR–ER終點之外帶來額外且持續的效益，仍未被量化。本研究旨在提供證據，支持多維度緩解對UC重要結局具有階層式效益。
方法：我們系統性搜尋Medline、EMBASE及Cochrane CENTRAL，自資料庫建置起至2025年5月19日，納入收錄處於CR的成人UC病人、追蹤至少6個月的世代研究，比較達到ER與未達ER、達到HR與未達HR，及／或達到BR與未達BR病人的復發風險、重新使用類固醇、住院、結腸切除及大腸直腸癌發生率。資料使用隨機效應統合分析進行整合，並以GRADE評估證據確定性。
結果：共納入94項研究（12,634名病人）。相較於未達ER，達到ER在6至未滿60個月期間可降低44%–72%的復發風險，並在12個月時降低70%的重新使用類固醇風險〔相對風險（RR）0.30，95%信賴區間0.10–0.90；證據確定性極低〕。在CR＋ER之外再達到HR，於所有追蹤區間可進一步降低51%–72%的復發風險：12–24個月為0.46〔0.34–0.62；證據確定性中等〕、24–36個月為0.48〔0.36–0.64；證據確定性中等〕、48–60個月為0.28〔0.16–0.51；證據確定性低〕，以及至少60個月為0.49〔0.34–0.71；證據確定性低〕。在CR＋ER之外再達到BR，於12個月時可額外降低71%的風險〔0.29，0.16–0.50；證據確定性中等〕，於至少60個月時可降低29%的風險〔0.71，0.51–0.97；證據確定性極低〕。
結論：此統合分析顯示，UC的多維度緩解具有階層式效益。在CR–ER終點之外達到HR或BR，可大幅且持續降低復發風險。這些結果提示，可考慮將HR及BR作為潛在治療目標，以優化長期疾病控制。

papers.title: Reduced adenoma miss rate with two versus a single forward-view examination of the proximal colon: a prospective, randomized tandem trial
papers.authors: Zhu X, Cheng F, Li X, Wu Z, Dai H, Leng F
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIM: Missed lesions in the proximal colon are a common cause of interval colorectal cancers detected before the next surveillance colonoscopy. This study aimed to determine whether two forward-view examinations of the proximal colon could reduce the adenoma miss rate compared to a single forward-view examination.
METHODS: Patients undergoing screening colonoscopy were enrolled in the study. After completing the first forward-view examination of the proximal colon (pass 1), patients were randomly assigned to either the intervention group, in which the proximal colon was re-examined twice (pass 2 and 3), or the control group, in which it was re-examined once (pass 2). The primary outcome was the proximal adenoma miss rate, defined as the number of proximal adenomas detected in the final pass (pass 3 for the intervention group and pass 2 for the control group) divided by the total number of proximal adenomas detected in that group.
RESULTS: A total of 403 patients were enrolled (intervention group, n = 202; control group, n = 201). The proximal adenoma miss rate in the intervention group was significantly lower than that in the control group (10.8%; 95% CI 6.5% - 17.2% vs. 28.1%; 95% CI 20.7% - 36.9%, P < 0.001). The proximal polyp miss rate (16.0%; 95% CI 12.4% - 20.3% vs. 35.5%; 95% CI 30.2% - 41.3%, P < 0.001)and the proximal sessile serrated lesions miss rate (12.0%; 95% CI 3.2% - 32.3% vs. 40.0%; 95% CI 20.0% - 63.6%, P = 0.03) in the intervention group were also lower than those in the control group. Multivariate analysis showed that adenomas detected on the first proximal colon examination and the use of a single forward-view examination were both independent predictors of missed adenomas on the first withdrawal from the proximal colon.
CONCLUSION: Two forward-view examinations of the proximal colon significantly reduced the proximal adenoma miss rate, proximal polyp miss rate and proximal sessile serrated lesions miss rate in patients undergoing screening colonoscopy.

papers.title_zh: 近端結腸兩次相較於單次前視檢查可降低腺瘤漏診率：前瞻性隨機串聯試驗
papers.abstract_zh:
背景與目的：近端結腸病灶漏診，是在下一次監測大腸鏡之前發現之間隔大腸直腸癌的常見原因。本研究旨在確定，近端結腸兩次前視檢查相較於單次前視檢查，是否能降低腺瘤漏診率。
方法：本研究納入接受篩檢大腸鏡的病人。完成近端結腸第一次前視檢查（第1次檢查）後，病人被隨機分配至介入組或對照組；介入組再接受兩次近端結腸檢查（第2及第3次檢查），對照組則再接受一次檢查（第2次檢查）。主要結果為近端結腸腺瘤漏診率，定義為最後一次檢查（介入組為第3次，對照組為第2次）發現的近端結腸腺瘤數，除以該組檢出的近端結腸腺瘤總數。
結果：共納入403名病人（介入組202名；對照組201名）。介入組的近端結腸腺瘤漏診率顯著低於對照組（10.8%；95% CI 6.5%–17.2%，相較於28.1%；95% CI 20.7%–36.9%，P<0.001）。介入組的近端結腸息肉漏診率（16.0%；95% CI 12.4%–20.3%，相較於35.5%；95% CI 30.2%–41.3%，P<0.001）及近端結腸無蒂鋸齒狀病灶漏診率（12.0%；95% CI 3.2%–32.3%，相較於40.0%；95% CI 20.0%–63.6%，P=0.03）也低於對照組。多變項分析顯示，首次近端結腸檢查發現腺瘤，以及僅進行單次前視檢查，皆為近端結腸首次退鏡時漏診腺瘤的獨立預測因子。
結論：在接受篩檢大腸鏡的病人中，近端結腸兩次前視檢查可顯著降低近端結腸腺瘤、息肉及無蒂鋸齒狀病灶的漏診率。
試驗註冊：本研究由景德鎮市第三人民醫院於ClinicalTrials.gov註冊（編號：NCT05712304；日期：2023/01/25）。

papers.title: Cardiovascular and lipid parameters in pediatric inflammatory bowel disease: systematic review & meta-analysis
papers.authors: Karatisidou V, Stoimeni A, Gkiourtzis N, Glava A, Saliakellis E, Fotoulaki M
papers.abstract:
UNLABELLED: Although inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) may lead to an increased risk of cardiovascular disease, evidence regarding cardiovascular and lipid parameters in childhood is limited. We compared vascular markers, blood pressure and lipid levels between patients with pediatric or childhood-onset IBD and controls. This study was performed according to the Cochrane Handbook for Systematic Reviews of Interventions and adhered to PRISMA guidelines. A search of major databases (MEDLINE/PubMed, Scopus and Cochrane Library) was conducted from inception until April 24, 2025 (CRD420251039588). The study quality was evaluated using the modified Newcastle-Ottawa Scale; statistical analysis was conducted using R software. Reactive hyperemia index (RHI) was lower in three studies, involving 109 participants (MD - 0.25, 95% CI - 0.48 to - 0.02; p = 0.03). No statistically significant difference in carotid intima-media thickness (cIMT) was detected based on six studies. Primary systolic blood pressure (SBP) pooling across ten studies, was also not statistically significant (MD 0.84 mmHg, 95% CI - 0.67 to 2.35; p = 0.28). The exclusion of one influential study resulted in a small difference in SBP (MD 1.89 mmHg, 95% CI 1.17 to 2.61). Primary analyses detected no statistically significant differences in diastolic blood pressure or lipid levels.
CONCLUSIONS: Lower RHI suggests possible early endothelial dysfunction, but the evidence is preliminary. No difference was observed in cIMT, DBP and lipid levels between the two groups. Future prospective cohort studies should investigate the longitudinal changes in these parameters, in order to elucidate whether early alterations lead, in the long-term, to increased cardiovascular morbidity in adulthood.
WHAT IS KNOWN: • Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is characterized by persistent gastrointestinal inflammation and immune activation. • IBD may lead to an elevated risk of cardiovascular disease. However, limited data exist regarding cardiovascular parameters on pediatric IBD patients.
WHAT IS NEW: • Lower Reactive Hyperemia Index (RHI) suggests possible endothelial dysfunction; carotid intima-media thickness (cIMT) and lipid levels remain inconclusive. • No statistically significant difference in cIMT was detected between participants with IBD and controls; primary systolic blood pressure (SBP) pooling was not statistically significant; a small increase appeared only after exclusion of one study.

papers.title_zh: 兒童發炎性腸道疾病的心血管與血脂參數：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
未分類摘要：雖然發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）可能導致心血管疾病風險增加，但兒童期心血管與血脂參數的相關證據仍有限。我們比較兒童IBD或兒童期發病IBD病人與對照組的血管指標、血壓及血脂濃度。本研究依據《Cochrane介入性研究系統性回顧手冊》執行，並遵循PRISMA指引。搜尋主要資料庫（MEDLINE/PubMed、Scopus及Cochrane Library），範圍自資料庫建置起至2025年4月24日（CRD420251039588）。研究品質以修正版Newcastle–Ottawa量表評估；統計分析使用R軟體進行。納入109名受試者的3項研究顯示，反應性充血指數（RHI）較低（平均差〔MD〕−0.25，95%信賴區間−0.48至−0.02；p＝0.03）。根據6項研究，未偵測到頸動脈內膜中層厚度（cIMT）具有統計顯著差異。合併10項研究的主要收縮壓（SBP）分析亦未達統計顯著（MD 0.84 mmHg，95%信賴區間−0.67至2.35；p＝0.28）。排除1項具影響力的研究後，SBP出現小幅差異（MD 1.89 mmHg，95%信賴區間1.17至2.61）。主要分析未發現舒張壓或血脂濃度有統計顯著差異。
結論：較低的RHI提示可能存在早期內皮功能異常，但證據仍屬初步。兩組間的cIMT、舒張壓（DBP）及血脂濃度未觀察到差異。未來應以前瞻性世代研究探討這些參數的縱向變化，以釐清早期變化是否會在長期導致成年期心血管疾病罹病增加。
已知事項：• IBD的特徵為持續性腸胃道發炎及免疫活化。• IBD可能導致心血管疾病風險升高。然而，兒童IBD病人心血管參數的相關資料有限。
新增知識：• 較低的反應性充血指數（RHI）提示可能存在內皮功能異常；頸動脈內膜中層厚度（cIMT）及血脂濃度的結果仍無定論。• IBD受試者與對照組之間的cIMT未偵測到統計顯著差異；收縮壓（SBP）的主要合併分析未達統計顯著；只有排除1項研究後才出現小幅升高。

papers.title: Temporal strain-resolved metagenomics associates IBD dysbiosis with gastrointestinal inflammation
papers.authors: Ansorge R, Romano S, Frioux C, Korcsmáros T, Yoou M, Juge N
papers.abstract: The gut microbiome in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is enriched in proinflammatory bacteria, yet defining a consistent dysbiotic signature is challenging, due to substantial variation between individuals and over time. We performed a high-resolution meta-analysis of 4,839 public metagenomes to disentangle the effects of IBD subtypes, inflammation, temporal, and individual variability. After accounting for temporal variation, we show that IBD-associated dysbiosis was characterized primarily by relative depletion of commensal bacteria rather than expansion of disease-associated taxa, together with increased microbiome variability both within and between individuals. Although 30% of species were IBD-associated, only 73% of these associations remained consistent across all timepoints. IBD-associated bacteria showed reduced persistence within hosts, increased strain loss and diminished strain engraftment. 8% of commensal species displayed strain-level associations with IBD that were independent of species-level changes, suggesting distinct ecological strategies for persistence. Finally, defining an inflammatory index, we demonstrated that inflammation explains much of the observed variation in microbial composition and abundance. Together, our findings indicate that inflammation associates and likely contributes to loss of commensals, thereby limiting microbiome recovery and resilience.

papers.title_zh: 時間序列菌株解析宏基因組學揭示 IBD 菌相失衡與胃腸道發炎的關聯
papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）患者的腸道微生物相中，促發炎細菌較為富集；然而，由於個體之間及隨時間的變異相當大，要界定一致的菌相失衡特徵仍具挑戰。我們對4,839份公開宏基因組資料進行高解析度統合分析，以釐清IBD亞型、發炎、時間及個體變異各自的影響。將時間變異納入考量後，我們顯示，IBD相關菌相失衡的主要特徵是共生細菌的相對減少，而非疾病相關菌群的擴增，同時伴隨個體內及個體間微生物相變異增加。雖然30%的物種與IBD相關，但這些關聯中僅73%在所有時間點均保持一致。IBD相關細菌在宿主內的持續存在程度較低、菌株流失增加，且菌株定殖減少。8%的共生物種呈現與IBD相關、且獨立於物種層級變化的菌株層級關聯，提示其具有不同的持續存留生態策略。最後，透過定義一項發炎指數，我們證明發炎可解釋所觀察到的微生物組成與豐度變異中的很大一部分。整體而言，我們的發現指出，發炎與共生菌流失相關，且很可能促成其流失，進而限制微生物相的恢復與韌性。

papers.title: Robot-assisted versus laparoscopic-assisted radical right hemicolectomy: short-term and 5-year outcomes in 2057 cases
papers.authors: Li T, Zhou R, He P, Liang Y, Xiao F, Hu W
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: With the increasing application of robotic surgical systems in the field of gastrointestinal surgery, their technical advantages in achieving precise dissection and stable manipulation have become increasingly evident in clinical practice. This study aims to compare the perioperative outcomes and long-term survival outcomes of robot-assisted radical right hemicolectomy (RA) and laparoscopic-assisted radical right hemicolectomy (LA) for colon cancer.
METHODS: This study is a retrospective analysis; a total of 2057 patients with right-sided colon cancer were enrolled from the First Affiliated Hospital of Nanchang University between 2015 and 2020. No significant differences were observed in baseline characteristics between the two groups. The primary endpoints of this study were 5-year cancer-specific survival (CSS) and disease-free survival (DFS) after surgery, while the secondary endpoints were perioperative outcomes.
RESULTS: The RA group was associated with significantly higher 5-year CSS and DFS than the LA group (CSS: 79.9% vs. 74.6%, p = 0.005; DFS: 74.2% vs. 67.3%, p = 0.001). Surgical approach was an independent prognostic factor for both CSS and DFS (CSS: hazard ratio (HR) = 0.75, p = 0.008; DFS: HR = 0.75, p = 0.002). For perioperative outcomes, the RA group was associated with less intraoperative blood loss, more lymph nodes harvested (both p < 0.001), and a lower complication rate (p = 0.001).
CONCLUSIONS: RA was associated with more favourable perioperative outcomes and better long-term survival than LA.
This is the first large-scale retrospective study (n = 2057) with 5-year follow-up comparing robot-assisted and laparoscopic-assisted radical right hemicolectomy. It fills a long-term evidence gap and suggests that robotic surgery may offer certain short-term benefits, warranting further prospective validation.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：隨著機器人手術系統在胃腸外科領域的應用日益增加，其在精準剝離與穩定操作方面的技術優勢，在臨床實務中已愈來愈明顯。本研究旨在比較機器人輔助根治性右半結腸切除術（RA）與腹腔鏡輔助根治性右半結腸切除術（LA）治療結腸癌的圍手術期結果與長期存活結果。
方法：本研究為回溯性分析，納入2015年至2020年間南昌大學第一附屬醫院共2057名右側結腸癌病人。兩組基線特徵未觀察到顯著差異。本研究主要終點為術後5年癌症特異性存活（CSS）及無病存活（DFS），次要終點為圍手術期結果。
結果：RA組的5年CSS及DFS顯著高於LA組（CSS：79.9% vs. 74.6%，p = 0.005；DFS：74.2% vs. 67.3%，p = 0.001）。手術方式是CSS與DFS的獨立預後因子（CSS：風險比〔HR〕= 0.75，p = 0.008；DFS：HR = 0.75，p = 0.002）。在圍手術期結果方面，RA組與較少的術中出血量、較多的淋巴結取得數（兩者皆p < 0.001），以及較低的併發症發生率（p = 0.001）相關。
結論：RA與較佳的圍手術期結果及較好的長期存活相關。
這是首篇比較機器人輔助與腹腔鏡輔助根治性右半結腸切除術、具5年追蹤的大型回溯性研究（n = 2057）。本研究填補了長期證據的缺口，並提示機器人手術可能具有某些短期益處，值得進一步以前瞻性研究驗證。

papers.title: Time-to-response in acute severe ulcerative colitis: when to continue, optimize, or stop treatment
papers.abstract: Acute severe ulcerative colitis is an emergency in which treatment selection and timing are inseparable. This narrative review synthesizes published response trajectories and proposes treatment-specific futility windows for inpatient therapies, including intravenous corticosteroids, cyclosporine, infliximab, Janus kinase inhibitors, calcineurin-inhibitor bridging strategies, and sequential rescue. We propose that trajectory should override any protocol day. Deterioration, systemic toxicity, worsening abdominal findings, organ dysfunction, or radiologic complications should prompt immediate escalation and surgical reassessment rather than waiting for a scheduled checkpoint. Conversely, objective improvement without remission may justify cautious continuation. Therapeutic stagnation requires integrating stool frequency, bleeding, systemic features, C-reactive protein, albumin, hemoglobin, imaging, informative endoscopy, pharmacokinetic exposure when available, and surgical risk. For intravenous corticosteroids, assessment starts at admission; day 3 guides rescue preparation; if no deterioration occurs beforehand, lack of meaningful objective improvement by day 5 should prompt rescue therapy or surgery. Cyclosporine usually declares its trajectory within the first week. For infliximab, days 5-7 are the principal clinical decision window; stable patients with inadequate exposure may undergo optimization, with later reassessment reserved for partial responders. Tofacitinib and upadacitinib may act rapidly; off-label rescue evidence remains observational, and absent improvement by days 5-7 is concerning. When a calcineurin inhibitor (CNI) bridges to a maintenance biologic, acute decisions should be based on response to the CNI, not the maintenance agent. Sequential third-line rescue should be exceptional, multidisciplinary, time-limited, and never delay colectomy when deterioration or a surgical indication is present. Across therapies, reassessment must be paired with continuous surgical involvement.

papers.title_zh: 急性重症潰瘍性結腸炎的治療反應時間：何時繼續、最佳化或停止治療
papers.abstract_zh: 急性重症潰瘍性結腸炎是一種急症，治療選擇與時機密不可分。本敘述性綜述整合已發表的治療反應軌跡，並針對住院治療提出各療法特定的無效判定時間窗，涵蓋靜脈類固醇、cyclosporine、infliximab、Janus kinase抑制劑、鈣調神經磷酸酶抑制劑橋接策略，以及序貫救援治療。我們主張，病情變化軌跡應優先於任何治療流程規定的天數。病況惡化、全身性毒性表現、腹部臨床所見惡化、器官功能障礙，或影像學併發症，均應促使立即升級治療並重新進行外科評估，而非等待預定的評估時點。相反地，已有客觀改善但尚未緩解，可能足以支持審慎延續治療。若治療反應停滯，需整合排便頻率、出血、全身性表現、C反應蛋白、白蛋白、血紅素、影像檢查、可提供決策資訊的內視鏡檢查、可取得時的藥物動力學暴露資訊，以及手術風險。對於靜脈類固醇，評估應自入院開始；第3天的評估用以引導救援治療的準備；若此前未出現惡化，至第5天仍缺乏有意義的客觀改善，應啟動救援治療或手術。Cyclosporine的反應軌跡通常會在第一週內明朗。對於infliximab，第5–7天是主要臨床決策時間窗；病況穩定但藥物暴露不足者可進行治療最佳化，而較晚的再次評估應保留給部分反應者。Tofacitinib與upadacitinib可能快速起效；仿單適應症外救援治療的證據仍屬觀察性資料，至第5–7天仍未改善是令人擔憂的訊號。當以鈣調神經磷酸酶抑制劑（CNI）橋接至維持治療用生物製劑時，急性期決策應依據對CNI的反應，而非維持治療藥物的反應。序貫第三線救援治療應僅限例外情況，由多專科共同決策，並設有時間限制；一旦病況惡化或出現手術適應症，絕不可因此延誤大腸切除。所有療法的再評估，都必須伴隨外科團隊持續參與。

papers.title: Cytomegalovirus in severe colitis: diagnostic pitfalls and a pragmatic testing framework
papers.journal_full: Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology
papers.authors: Khan M, Taifour R, Al-Dury S
papers.abstract: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) is an important complication of severe colitis, particularly in patients with ulcerative colitis (UC), corticosteroid-refractory disease, and significant immunosuppression. However, clinically relevant CMV involvement may also occur in patients without conventional immunosuppressive risk factors, whilst CMV may be detected as secondary or low-level reactivation in severely inflamed mucosa. Distinguishing clinically significant CMV-associated disease from incidental viral detection remains a diagnostic challenge. Clinical and endoscopic features are insufficiently specific, and interpretation is complicated by differences in the sensitivity, specificity, and clinical meaning of diagnostic tests. This Mini Review examines the roles and limitations of histology, immunohistochemistry (IHC), tissue polymerase chain reaction (PCR), and blood CMV PCR in adults presenting with severe colitis. Attention is given to mucosal sampling, the patchy distribution of CMV, the limited sensitivity of blood-based testing for isolated colonic disease, and the uncertain significance of low-level tissue CMV DNA detected by highly sensitive molecular techniques. We propose a pragmatic testing framework in which immune status informs, but does not alone determine, the threshold for CMV investigation. Disease severity, clinical trajectory, response to initial therapy, and compatible endoscopic features should guide the decision to obtain tissue-based testing. IHC remains central to identifying infected mucosal cells, whilst tissue PCR should be interpreted alongside histopathology, viral burden, and clinical context rather than used alone to establish disease. A severity- and trajectory-guided approach may improve recognition of clinically significant CMV involvement whilst reducing both inappropriate escalation of immunosuppression in unrecognised CMV disease and unnecessary antiviral treatment of low-level viral reactivation.

papers.abstract_zh: 巨細胞病毒（CMV）感染是重度結腸炎的重要併發症，尤其見於潰瘍性結腸炎（UC）、類固醇治療無反應及明顯免疫抑制的病人。然而，沒有傳統免疫抑制危險因子的病人，也可能出現具有臨床意義的 CMV 侵犯；另一方面，在嚴重發炎的黏膜中偵測到 CMV，也可能只是次發性或低程度的病毒再活化。區分具有臨床意義的 CMV 相關疾病與偶然偵測到病毒，仍是診斷上的挑戰。臨床與內視鏡表現的特異性不足，而各項診斷檢測在敏感度、特異度及臨床意義上的差異，也使結果判讀更加複雜。本篇迷你綜述探討組織學、免疫組織化學染色（IHC）、組織聚合酶連鎖反應（PCR）及血液 CMV PCR，在成人重度結腸炎中的角色與限制。本文特別關注黏膜採樣、CMV 的斑片狀分布、血液檢測對侷限於結腸之疾病的敏感度有限，以及高敏感度分子檢測所偵測到之低量組織 CMV DNA，其意義仍不明確等問題。我們提出一個務實的檢測架構：免疫狀態應作為設定 CMV 檢查門檻的參考，但不應是唯一決定因素。是否取得組織進行檢測，應由疾病嚴重度、臨床病程走向、對初始治療的反應，以及相符的內視鏡表現共同引導。IHC 仍是辨識受感染黏膜細胞的核心工具；組織 PCR 則應結合組織病理、病毒量及臨床情境判讀，而不應單獨用來確立疾病診斷。以疾病嚴重度與病程走向為導向的方法，可能有助於辨識具有臨床意義的 CMV 侵犯，同時減少對未被辨識的 CMV 疾病不當加強免疫抑制，以及對低程度病毒再活化給予不必要抗病毒治療的情形。

papers.title: Stem Cells and Derivatives in Inflammatory Bowel Disease: Mechanisms, Sources, and Therapeutic Perspectives
papers.authors: Cappa Spina A, Puca P, Troisi S, Petito V, Masi L, Migliore G
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD), including Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, are chronic, relapsing disorders of the gastrointestinal tract for which a substantial proportion of patients fail to respond to current therapies, underscoring the need for novel strategies. Mesenchymal stromal cells (MSCs) and their derivatives have emerged as a promising frontier in regenerative medicine, owing to their self-renewal capacity, multilineage differentiation, and potent immunomodulatory properties. MSCs modulate the intestinal microenvironment by suppressing effector T-cell responses, expanding regulatory T (Treg) and B (Breg) cells, polarizing macrophages toward anti-inflammatory phenotypes, reducing pro-inflammatory cytokines, and shaping the gut microbiota. Most of these effects are mediated by paracrine signals carried by the MSC secretome and extracellular vesicles (EVs), which deliver cytokines, microRNAs, and proteins that promote tissue repair, angiogenesis, and resolution of inflammation. Cell-free approaches based on conditioned medium or exosomes offer further advantages over direct cell transplantation, including improved safety, easier standardization, and reduced immunogenicity. MSCs derived from bone marrow, adipose tissue, and perinatal tissues each show distinct biological and therapeutic features. The treatment of complex perianal fistulas in Crohn's disease is the most clinically advanced application, with darvadstrocel demonstrating safety and efficacy in clinical trials. Additional emerging indications include intestinal fibrosis and tissue regeneration. Key challenges remain, including cellular heterogeneity, lack of standardized manufacturing, and optimization of dosing and delivery. Future perspectives point toward a paradigm shift from cell-based therapies to next generation cell-free strategies, including secretome-derived formulations and engineered extracellular vescicles, which may provide safer, more scalable and ultimately disease-modifying therapeutic options for patients with IBD.

papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD），包括克隆氏症與潰瘍性結腸炎，是胃腸道慢性、反覆發作的疾病，其中相當比例的病人對現有治療無反應，凸顯開發新策略的必要性。間質基質細胞（MSCs）及其衍生物因具有自我更新能力、多向分化潛能及強大的免疫調節特性，已成為再生醫學中備受期待的前沿領域。MSCs 透過抑制效應 T 細胞反應、擴增調節型 T 細胞（Treg）與調節型 B 細胞（Breg）、促使巨噬細胞朝抗發炎表型極化、降低促發炎細胞激素，以及調整腸道微生物群，來調節腸道微環境。這些作用大多由 MSC 分泌體與細胞外囊泡（EVs）所攜帶的旁分泌訊號介導；它們傳遞細胞激素、微小 RNA 及蛋白質，促進組織修復、血管新生與發炎消退。相較於直接細胞移植，以條件培養液或外泌體為基礎的無細胞策略具有額外優勢，包括更佳的安全性、更容易標準化，以及較低的免疫原性。源自骨髓、脂肪組織及周產期組織的 MSCs，各自呈現不同的生物學與治療特性。克隆氏症複雜性肛周瘻管的治療，是目前臨床發展最成熟的應用，其中 darvadstrocel 已在臨床試驗中展現安全性與療效。其他新興適應症包括腸道纖維化與組織再生。目前仍存在重要挑戰，包括細胞異質性、缺乏標準化製程，以及劑量與遞送方式的最佳化。未來展望指向由細胞治療轉向下一代無細胞策略的典範轉移，包括分泌體衍生製劑與工程化細胞外囊泡，這些策略可能為 IBD 病人提供更安全、更易於規模化，且最終能改變疾病進程的治療選項。

papers.title: Hydrogen sulfide in colorectal cancer: mechanisms, roles, and therapeutic potential
papers.authors: Li H, Chen Y, Hua J, Jiang Z, Xu Y, Fu X
papers.abstract: Hydrogen sulfide (H2S) is an endogenous gasotransmitter. The effect of H2S in colorectal cancer depends on the balance between its biosynthesis and mitochondrial clearance via sulfide:quinone oxidoreductase. In colorectal cancer, the upregulation of cystathionine β-synthase and suppression of sulfide:quinone oxidoreductase lead to increased H2S levels. H2S primarily acts through persulfidation, a reversible redox modification that regulates metabolic reprogramming, redox homeostasis, and cell fate. Moderate levels of H2S promote proliferation, angiogenesis, and immune evasion, whereas supraphysiological levels of H2S induce oxidative cell death. This review analyzes H2S dysregulation in colorectal cancer, the role of persulfidation in reshaping metabolic networks and the tumor microenvironment, and its potential as a biomarker. We also summarize therapeutic strategies, including cystathionine β-synthase inhibitors, H2S-responsive nanotheranostics, and combinations thereof, that target H2S-driven metabolic and immune vulnerabilities. Although still in the early stages, the H2S/persulfidation axis has translational value, and warrants further investigation.

papers.title: Vaccination in Adult Patients with Inflammatory Bowel Disease: An Updated Practical Approach
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE OF REVIEW: Due to both disease-mediated and therapy-induced immunosuppression, patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) are at increased risk of infections, including from vaccine preventable diseases (VPDs). As such, prevention through vaccination is a key aspect of longitudinal care to decrease infection-associated morbidity. In this review, we aim to outline a practical approach to vaccination in patients with IBD.
RECENT FINDINGS: The importance of vaccination for prevention of VPDs has been highlighted in multiple societal guideline updates. In recent years, these guidelines have expanded to include updated recommendations for coronavirus disease 2019, respiratory syncytial virus, and hepatitis B virus immunization. Additional guidance regarding use of live vaccines has also been provided. Having a practical and patient-centered approach to vaccination in patients with IBD is an important part of longitudinal care and prevention of morbidity. Herein we have highlighted risks of infection, the contributing role of immunosuppressive therapy, and comprehensively reviewed recommendations for and approach to vaccination.

papers.abstract_zh:
回顧目的：由於疾病本身及治療所造成的免疫抑制，發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）患者的感染風險增加，其中包括疫苗可預防疾病（VPDs）所造成的感染。因此，透過疫苗接種進行預防，是長期照護的重要環節，可降低感染相關罹病負擔。本篇綜述旨在概述IBD患者疫苗接種的實務作法。
近期發現：多個專業學會更新的指引，均強調疫苗接種對預防VPDs的重要性。近年來，這些指引已擴大納入2019冠狀病毒疾病、呼吸道融合病毒及B型肝炎病毒疫苗接種的更新建議。此外，也提供了使用活性疫苗的進一步指引。為IBD患者採取務實且以病人為中心的疫苗接種作法，是長期照護及預防罹病負擔的重要部分。本文著重說明感染風險、免疫抑制治療在其中所扮演的角色，並全面回顧疫苗接種建議與實務作法。
papers.score_reason: 對參與IBD共同照護的外科醫師有實用性，值得在需要更新疫苗處置時查閱全文。但摘要僅概述指引更新，未提供具體接種條件、證據品質或效益數據，無法據此判斷建議強度。
papers.relevance_why: 與接受免疫抑制治療之IBD患者的共同照護相關，但未直接處理手術決策或術後感染預防。

papers.title: Age is Just a Number: Treatment Considerations for Older Adults with Inflammatory Bowel Disease
papers.authors: Drittel D, Chung B, Faye A
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE OF REVIEW: The purpose of this review is to synthesize the recent evidence regarding efficacy and safety of advanced therapies and surgical interventions in older adults with IBD, as well as examine how geriatric factors (frailty, multimorbidity, polypharmacy, and patient priorities) should influence the selection of therapies in this population.
FINDINGS: Ongoing inflammation is often a key driver of adverse outcomes in older adults with IBD, and the efficacy of biologics and small molecules is generally preserved in this population. Treatment selection should therefore prioritize efficacy while also accounting for comorbidities, infection and malignancy risk, and potential drug interactions; chronological age alone should not limit their use. Early surgery may also benefit appropriately selected patients, while functional assessment can identify those suitable for immediate intervention and those who may benefit from preoperative optimization. Across treatment decisions, the geriatric 5Ms, multicomplexity, medications, mobility, mind, and what matters most, can help guide individualized care. Treatment of older adults with IBD is complex and multidimensional. Management paradigms should shift away from therapeutic hesitancy on the basis of chronological age alone and towards an individualized approach that prioritizes effective disease control and symptom relief, thereby preserving function, independence, and promoting healthy aging for older adults with IBD.

papers.title_zh: 年齡只是數字：高齡發炎性腸道疾病成人患者的治療考量
papers.abstract_zh:
回顧目的：本綜述旨在整合高齡IBD成人患者接受進階治療與外科介入之療效及安全性的近期證據，並探討老年醫學因素（衰弱、多重共病、多重用藥及患者優先考量）應如何影響此族群的治療選擇。
研究發現：持續發炎往往是高齡IBD成人患者不良結局的重要驅動因素，而生物製劑與小分子藥物在此族群中的療效通常仍得以維持。因此，治療選擇應優先考量療效，同時兼顧共病、感染與惡性腫瘤風險，以及潛在藥物交互作用；不應僅因實際年齡而限制其使用。對經適當篩選的患者，早期手術也可能有益；功能評估則可辨識哪些患者適合立即介入，以及哪些患者可能受益於術前最佳化。在各項治療決策中，老年醫學5Ms——多重複雜性、用藥、行動能力、心智，以及患者最重視的事——可協助引導個人化照護。高齡IBD成人患者的治療既複雜又涉及多個面向。照護模式應從僅因實際年齡而對治療猶豫不決，轉向優先重視有效疾病控制與症狀緩解的個人化方式，藉此維持高齡IBD成人患者的功能與獨立性，並促進健康老化。
